Founded by Late Shri Abheraj H. Baldota, a pioneering entrepreneur with a vision to serve the nation and the foresight to capture value in India’s vast reserve of high-grade iron ore, the Baldota Group was born. Under his aegis the Baldota group transformed itself from a fledgling mining company to a diversified business empire. We conscientiously work towards achieving leadership in every domain that we operate in. We add value to our iron ore products through forward integration and leveraging our clean development mechanism (CDM) status in wind power. Built around core values laid down by our beloved guiding founder, we have also demonstrated steadfast commitment towards the communities we work in and have been cited for our environmental consciousness. These solutions address wastewater and solid waste treatment. Products and technologies provided by these companies are aimed at enhancing environmental quality, by removing odour, and improving recycling and reuse. We are constantly innovating in our full-fledged R&D laboratory, through extensive research by industry-experienced scientists and state-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities. We offer a bouquet of products and services for a host of customers like residential colonies, municipalities, and industries. Our groundbreaking and patented products are meant for odour removal and treatment of domestic sewage and industrial wastewater. They are equally effective in managing solid waste odour.
